def fn(t0, t1, k, lst, dct):
    t1[1] = k
    t0.clamp_(-2, 4)
    t1.add_(k)
    v1 = t1 * 1
    v2 = torch.select_scatter(t1, v1.select(2, 1), 2, 1)
    v1.masked_fill_(t1 > 2, 0)
    v3 = t1.unfold(1, 1, 2)
    v3[v3 > -2] = 0
    v4 = v1.transpose(1, 0)
    v5 = v3[1, 1:2, 0:1, :]
    return (v1, v5, t0, v1, lst, dct)
